subject: Procurement approval timing and rolling billing exemption
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightleaf.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement onboarding — billing cadence & PO header requirements

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for the sandbox and pilot, but Procurement has two non-standard asks before we can issue a blanket PO:

1) Billing cadence: our ERP requires consolidated monthly invoices for vendor payments. We _can_ accept weekly invoices only if each invoice contains a unique PO line ID and an entity code that maps to our weekly payrun. Otherwise finance will reject multiple weekly invoices.

2) PO header/fields: finance has a strict PO template (attached) — mandatory fields are: BU_CODE, ERPCODE, PO_LINE_ID, SERVICE_MONTH, and TAX_REGION. They want invoice lines to include PO_LINE_ID so the AR team can auto-match.

3) Net terms: Standard for BrightLeaf vendor contracts is Net30. Your pricing deck showed Net45; Procurement has asked if you can support Net30 or provide a discount to offset the shorter float.

We understand this is a bit prescriptive. Our goal is to avoid repeated rejections when invoices hit the payrun. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- produce a single monthly consolidated invoice (preferred), OR
- if weekly invoices are required, include PO_LINE_ID and ERPCODE on each invoice line
- accept Net30 or provide a short-term credit/discount to bridge to Net45

Attached: BrightLeaf_PO_requirements.csv — this is the file procurement passed to me.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can get our legal and AP teams moving.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
BrightLeaf Health
--Attachment: BrightLeaf_PO_requirements.csv (text/csv)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding — billing cadence & PO header requirements

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear note and the template. Looping in Ben (sales) and Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (contracts) to confirm feasibility.

Short answers up front: we can support the PO fields you listed and produce a monthly consolidated invoice. We can also emit weekly invoices with the PO_LINE_ID/ERPCODE if you require a weekly payrun, but there are some implications:

- Monthly consolidated invoice: simplest for both sides. Redwood will emit one invoice per month that includes all charge lines for the service_month and the PO IDs on each line. No change to price; standard payment terms would apply (Net45).

- Weekly invoices with PO_LINE_ID per line: feasible, however our billing run cost increases and billing reconciliation overhead increases. Operationally we would require a mapping table (we attached a redwood_po_mapping_template.xlsx) so our AR can emit the correct ERPCODE/BU_CODE on each invoice line.

- Net terms: Ben / Sales — can we offer Net30 or a short-term credit for the initial 6 months? If Net30 is a hard requirement from BrightLeaf we can consider a 1.5% early-pay discount or a $5k implementation credit tied to the pilot acceptance.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm discount/net-term options.
2) Marissa to validate the mapping template and confirm any additional metadata we need.
3) Karthik to draft a short PO addendum (1 paragraph) that specifies invoice format and line mapping to avoid rejections.

We'll aim to get the mapping template back to you within 2 business days once Ben confirms pricing.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

On Tue, Jun 22, 2027 at 8:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samir — thanks for the clear note and the template. Looping in Ben (sales) and Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (contracts) to confirm feasibility.

Hi Samir, Vanessa — thanks for routing. Short commercial response below so you have something to share with Legal/Finance at BrightLeaf: 

Option A — Monthly consolidated invoice (preferred by Redwood):
- Pricing: standard list pricing as quoted in SOW v1.
- Terms: Net45 standard.
- Commercial concession: If BrightLeaf can commit to a 12-month paid pilot (minimum $150k ARR run-rate), Redwood will grant a 6% platform-level discount and accelerate implementation (priority onboarding).

Option B — Weekly invoices (to align with BrightLeaf weekly payrun):
- Pricing: list pricing + 1.25% operational surcharge to cover billing run frequency and reconciliation overhead.
- Terms: We can accept Net30 for the pilot term if BrightLeaf signs the 12-month commitment above; otherwise Net45 applies.

Operational notes:
- We will include PO_LINE_ID, ERPCODE and BU_CODE on every invoice line if you provide the mapping template — Marissa can consume that directly into our billing engine.
- We request acceptance of a short PO addendum (1 para) that defines mapping responsibilities and a 30-day mutual remediation window for any auto-match failures. Karthik — can you prepare that?

Samir — let me know which option Procurement prefers and whether the 12-month commitment is acceptable; we can spin a formal commercial term sheet quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben and Vanessa — appreciate the clear options. Procurement & Finance discussed internally and prefer Option A (monthly consolidated invoice) for our production cutover. A couple of confirmations before we proceed: 

1) BrightLeaf will move forward with the 12-month paid pilot at the $150k ARR run-rate you noted, subject to legal finalizing the PO addendum.
2) We accept the 6% platform-level discount tied to that commitment — please reflect this in the updated SOW.
3) Net30 is our standard; we can accept Net45 for the first month of the pilot only if Redwood provides a one-time $5k onboarding credit applied to month-1 invoice.

Action items: 
- Redwood (Karthik/Marissa) to return an updated SOW + PO addendum and the filled mapping template by EOD Mon 2027-06-28.
- BrightLeaf to issue a blanket PO after legal signs the addendum.

Attached: BrightLeaf_Sample_PO_20270625.pdf — this is the form procurement will use once the addendum is in place.

If we can get the updated docs by Monday, finance will queue the PO for the July payrun.

Regards,
Samir
